card.name: Capital H starting warning headings
card.fires_on: The letter H (or G) that begins an all-caps or sentence-initial medical term such as hematoma, hepatotoxicity, hyponatremia or heparin, mostly in boxed warning headings.

modes.label: All-caps warning titles
modes.description: The H opening a capitalized boxed-warning term after a colon or slash.

modes.description: A capital H or G starting a sentence or adverse-reaction term like heparin or gastrointestinal.
